correctness.rationale: For every finite connected simple unweighted (a,b)-biregular bipartite graph, all RK4 transition-entry types are reconstructed from the exact Laplacian block polynomials. A positive quadratic discriminant certificate, explicit positive cross-edge decomposition and sum-of-squares diagonal identity show nonnegativity through 2/(a+b). Every incomplete connected bipartite graph has a distance-three cross-class nonedge; its exact coefficient turns strictly negative beyond 2/(a+b). Complete bicliques have an exactly decreasing Q((a+b)h) cross-entry with unique root rho. The Laplacian top eigenvalue is exactly a+b, and the scalar RK4 stability polynomial yields the spectral bound rho/(a+b). Independent exact rational Laplacian matrix construction checks 9891 off-diagonal entries across 32 representative biregular cases, with symbolic polynomial identities/certificates. The infinite-family proof is analytic, not extrapolated from the finite tests.

originality.rationale: The conclusion is an all-connected-biregular-graph if-and-only-if biclique classification; previously recorded special families and general SSP/Runge-Kutta positivity theory do not logically entail the all-graph dichotomy. The compared 1998 and 2005 primary papers treat method-wide radii or invariant subclasses, not fixed-graph RK4 endpoint matrices. Actual published-finding corpus semantic searches for graph aliases, SSP equivalents, spectral gaps and distance-three witnesses found no matching published theorem. Residual specialized/unindexed-source risk is explicitly retained; failed search is not treated as mathematical proof of novelty.
residual_risks: A specialized historical graph-diffusion paper outside indexed semantic records could derive an equivalent classification.
The arXiv 2012 SSP reference was inspected in relevant introductory sections rather than exhaustively; it is not invoked to prove a whole-paper absence.

value.rationale: A natural mathematically complete classification collapses the positivity horizon of every finite connected biregular bipartite network to a universal formula depending only on degree sum and whether the graph is a biclique. The sharp distance-three structural failure mechanism and fixed universal spectral-to-positivity safety gap have direct meaning for stable yet physically nonnegative graph diffusion, unify several independently motivated special cases, and cover incidence networks that those cases miss. This is not a small numerical cutoff or recomputation of a known table.
